authSignInCopy.en: Manage edge fleet configuration through Arna SSO.
authSignInCopy.id: Kelola konfigurasi fleet edge melalui Arna SSO.

authPasswordLength.en: Password must be at least 8 characters

authMfaCopy.en: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
authMfaCopy.id: Masukkan kode 6 digit dari aplikasi autentikator.

authMfaLength.en: MFA code must be exactly 6 digits

authRegisterCopy.en: Create an Arna SSO account for the edge console.
authRegisterCopy.id: Buat akun Arna SSO untuk edge console.

authCheckEmailCopy.en: Enter the verification code to activate your account.
authCheckEmailCopy.id: Masukkan kode verifikasi untuk mengaktifkan akun.

authOrganizationCopy.en: Set up an organization to collaborate with your team.
authOrganizationCopy.id: Siapkan organisasi untuk berkolaborasi dengan tim Anda.

authOrganizationLength.en: Organization name must be at least 2 characters

authTenantCopy.en: You're almost there — create your tenant to get started.
authTenantCopy.id: Sedikit lagi — buat tenant untuk memulai.

authTenantLength.en: Tenant name must be at least 2 characters

authMissingCallback.en: SSO callback is missing code or state.
authMissingCallback.id: Callback SSO tidak memiliki code atau state.

authInvalidLogin.en: Invalid email or password. Please try again.
authInvalidLogin.id: Email atau kata sandi tidak valid. Coba lagi.

authInvalidMfa.en: Invalid MFA code. Please try again.
authInvalidMfa.id: Kode MFA tidak valid. Coba lagi.

authOrganizationMissing.en: Organization not found. Please create one first.
authOrganizationMissing.id: Organisasi tidak ditemukan. Buat organisasi terlebih dahulu.

authTenantMissing.en: Tenant not found. Please create one first.
authTenantMissing.id: Tenant tidak ditemukan. Buat tenant terlebih dahulu.

authRegistrationSuccess.en: Registration successful! Check your email for the OTP.
authRegistrationSuccess.id: Pendaftaran berhasil! Periksa email Anda untuk OTP.

authEmailMissing.en: Email not found. Please start registration again.
authEmailMissing.id: Email tidak ditemukan. Mulai pendaftaran kembali.

authOtpResent.en: OTP has been resent to your email.
authOtpResent.id: OTP telah dikirim ulang ke email Anda.

authCreateOrganizationFailed.en: Failed to create organization. Please try again.

authCreateTenantFailed.en: Failed to create tenant. Please try again.

authBootstrapWarning.en: Workspace module could not be initialized. You can retry later in settings.
authBootstrapWarning.id: Modul workspace tidak dapat diinisialisasi. Anda dapat mencoba lagi di pengaturan.

serviceLoading.en: Loading data from Our Lil Photobooth service…
serviceLoading.id: Memuat data dari service Our Lil Photobooth…

serviceError.en: The service data could not be loaded. Check the session or try again.
serviceError.id: Data service tidak dapat dimuat. Periksa sesi atau coba lagi.

notAvailableInService.en: This operation is defined by the product workflow but has no endpoint in the current Swagger contract. It remains a local simulation.
notAvailableInService.id: Operasi ini tercantum pada flow produk tetapi belum memiliki endpoint di kontrak Swagger saat ini. Operasi tetap berupa simulasi lokal.

serviceCreated.en: The record was created through the Our Lil Photobooth service.
serviceCreated.id: Data berhasil dibuat melalui service Our Lil Photobooth.

serviceCreateWarning.en: Submitting this form creates a real service record. Review the values before continuing.
serviceCreateWarning.id: Mengirim formulir ini akan membuat data nyata pada service. Periksa seluruh nilai sebelum melanjutkan.

serviceUpdated.en: The service record was updated successfully.

queuedLocalOnly.en: The command was recorded locally because this action has no service endpoint.
queuedLocalOnly.id: Perintah dicatat secara lokal karena aksi ini belum memiliki endpoint service.

serviceSyncNote.en: This sends PATCH /devices/{id}/sync using the active access token.
serviceSyncNote.id: Aksi ini mengirim PATCH /devices/{id}/sync menggunakan access token aktif.

deviceCommandAvailability.en: Config sync uses the live service. Pause, resume, hardware apply, and diagnostics stay local until matching endpoints are published.
deviceCommandAvailability.id: Sinkronisasi config memakai service aktif. Jeda, lanjutkan, penerapan hardware, dan diagnostik tetap lokal hingga endpoint terkait tersedia.

serviceReadOnly.en: Operational data is loaded from the authorized service. Sensitive identifiers remain limited to fields returned by the API.
serviceReadOnly.id: Data operasional dimuat dari service terotorisasi. Identitas sensitif tetap dibatasi pada field yang dikembalikan API.

paymentServiceNote.en: Payment records are read from the service. Refund is available only for paid records and always requires confirmation.
paymentServiceNote.id: Data pembayaran dibaca dari service. Refund hanya tersedia untuk data berstatus paid dan selalu membutuhkan konfirmasi.

refundWarning.en: This is a real service mutation and may change the payment state. Confirm the payment ID and audit reason.
refundWarning.id: Ini adalah mutasi service nyata dan dapat mengubah status pembayaran. Pastikan ID pembayaran dan alasan audit sudah benar.

metricsServiceNote.en: Each section shows the fields returned by its report endpoint. Empty numbers stay empty instead of being filled in.
metricsServiceNote.id: Setiap bagian menampilkan field yang dikembalikan endpoint laporannya. Angka kosong tetap kosong, tidak diisi dengan data rekaan.

reportFilterNote.en: Dates, campaign, and booth filter the revenue and funnel reports that accept them. Grouping applies to daily revenue. Overdue minutes apply to the session funnel. Batch applies to voucher batches. “-” means no filter.
reportFilterNote.id: Tanggal, campaign, dan booth memfilter laporan pendapatan dan funnel yang menerimanya. Pengelompokan berlaku untuk pendapatan harian. Menit terlambat berlaku untuk funnel sesi. Batch berlaku untuk voucher batch. “-” berarti tanpa filter.

hardwareProfilesCopy.en: Camera and printer profiles are loaded and created through the authorized service contract.
hardwareProfilesCopy.id: Profil kamera dan printer dimuat serta dibuat melalui kontrak service terotorisasi.

campaignDeploymentNote.en: Deployment scope is resolved from active booth assignments. Device lists stored in campaign JSON are no longer used as the source of truth.
campaignDeploymentNote.id: Cakupan deployment ditentukan dari assignment booth yang aktif. Daftar perangkat pada JSON campaign tidak lagi menjadi sumber utama.

emptyServiceRecords.en: No records are available from the service yet. Create one from the module overview, then return here to edit it.
emptyServiceRecords.id: Belum ada data dari service. Buat data dari halaman ringkasan modul, lalu kembali ke sini untuk mengeditnya.

chooseRecordFromList.en: Open a row from the list.

campaignErdNote.en: API requires only the campaign name. Status defaults to draft; price, session limit, window, template links and JSON policies are optional. Deployment readiness is a separate check.
campaignErdNote.id: API hanya mewajibkan nama campaign. Status bawaan adalah draft; harga, batas sesi, rentang waktu, relasi template, dan kebijakan JSON bersifat opsional. Kesiapan deployment diperiksa terpisah.

deploymentSource.en: Campaign → booth → device assignment → device is the authoritative deployment path.
deploymentSource.id: Campaign → booth → assignment perangkat → perangkat adalah jalur deployment yang kanonis.

endAssignmentNote.en: Ending an assignment sets its status to inactive and records an end time. This is not a hard delete.
endAssignmentNote.id: Mengakhiri assignment mengubah status menjadi inactive dan mencatat waktu akhir. Ini bukan hard delete.

assignmentOverlap.en: Another active assignment for this device overlaps. The API accepts this request, but deployment may be ambiguous.
assignmentOverlap.id: Assignment aktif lain untuk perangkat ini bertumpuk. API menerima permintaan ini, tetapi cakupan deployment bisa ambigu.

assignmentCampaignWindow.en: This active assignment is outside the campaign window or uses an inactive booth. The API permits it, but readiness may fail.
assignmentCampaignWindow.id: Assignment aktif ini di luar rentang campaign atau memakai booth nonaktif. API mengizinkan, tetapi pemeriksaan kesiapan bisa gagal.

boothCampaignLocked.en: This booth has assignment history. Moving it to another campaign may change the context of those records.
boothCampaignLocked.id: Booth ini memiliki riwayat assignment. Memindahkannya ke campaign lain dapat mengubah konteks data tersebut.

assignmentRequired.en: The device must have an active assignment to a booth in this campaign.
assignmentRequired.id: Perangkat harus memiliki assignment aktif ke booth dalam campaign ini.

voucherStateNote.en: This page shows current voucher records from the service. The ERD does not define an append-only voucher event ledger or reconciliation checkpoints.
voucherStateNote.id: Halaman ini menampilkan kondisi voucher saat ini dari service. ERD tidak mendefinisikan event ledger voucher append-only atau checkpoint rekonsiliasi.

readinessErdNote.en: Readiness follows the active device assignment, booth campaign, public campaign template, hardware profiles, and eligible voucher batch.
readinessErdNote.id: Readiness mengikuti assignment perangkat aktif, campaign booth, template campaign publik, profil hardware, dan voucher batch yang memenuhi syarat.

profileContractNote.en: Only the profile name is required by the service. Configure hardware-specific fields when known; blank optional fields are not fabricated.
profileContractNote.id: Hanya nama profil yang wajib menurut layanan. Isi detail perangkat keras jika diketahui; kolom opsional yang kosong tidak diisi dengan data rekaan.

demoNote.en: Supported modules use the Our Lil Photobooth service with the active access token. Features without Swagger endpoints remain explicitly marked local simulations.
demoNote.id: Modul yang didukung memakai service Our Lil Photobooth dengan access token aktif. Fitur tanpa endpoint Swagger tetap ditandai jelas sebagai simulasi lokal.

extra.en: Additional idea · not specified in PRD
extra.id: Ide tambahan · tidak dirinci di PRD

published.en: New revision created; awaiting device acknowledgement.
published.id: Revisi baru dibuat; menunggu acknowledgement perangkat.

reauthNote.en: This checkbox only demonstrates the re-authentication step; it does not verify identity.
reauthNote.id: Checkbox ini hanya memperagakan langkah autentikasi ulang; tidak memverifikasi identitas.

guard.en: Active sessions keep their immutable snapshot. Only new sessions use the new configuration. Hardware changes require explicit apply and a new preflight.
guard.id: Sesi aktif tetap memakai snapshot immutable. Hanya sesi baru yang memakai konfigurasi baru. Perubahan hardware memerlukan apply eksplisit dan preflight ulang.

range.en: Value is outside the permitted range.
range.id: Nilai berada di luar rentang yang diizinkan.

noChanges.id: Tidak ada perubahan pada perbandingan ini.

created.en: Record created as a local draft.

queued.en: Command recorded locally; execution and acknowledgement are pending.
queued.id: Perintah dicatat lokal; eksekusi dan acknowledgement masih menunggu.

retryNote.en: Only retryable jobs below the attempt limit are eligible. Reuse the same job and idempotency key. Conflict, active leases and dead-letter jobs are excluded.
retryNote.id: Hanya job retryable di bawah batas percobaan yang memenuhi syarat. Gunakan job dan kunci idempotensi yang sama. Konflik, lease aktif, dan dead-letter dikecualikan.

retryDone.en: Eligible jobs requeued locally. Attempts increase only when a worker executes them.
retryDone.id: Job aman diantrekan ulang lokal. Percobaan bertambah hanya saat worker mengeksekusi.

ledgerNote.en: Current voucher state from the service. The present ERD does not include an append-only redemption event ledger or reconciliation checkpoint.
ledgerNote.id: Kondisi voucher saat ini dari service. ERD saat ini belum memiliki event ledger penukaran append-only atau checkpoint rekonsiliasi.

offlineNote.en: New PAYG QRIS is never authorized offline. Offline admission requires valid cached signatures, campaign/device scope, clock, inventory and quota.
offlineNote.id: PAYG QRIS baru tidak pernah diotorisasi saat offline. Penerimaan offline memerlukan signature cache valid, cakupan campaign/perangkat, waktu, inventori, dan kuota.

retentionNote.en: Never delete unuploaded media, unacknowledged ledgers or allocations, or templates referenced by sessions/reprints. Cleanup requires verified upload AND elapsed retention.
retentionNote.id: Jangan hapus media belum diunggah, ledger/alokasi belum diakui, atau template yang masih dirujuk sesi/reprint. Cleanup memerlukan unggahan terverifikasi DAN masa retensi selesai.

immutable.en: Published versions are immutable. Saving creates or updates a separate draft.
immutable.id: Versi terpublikasi immutable. Penyimpanan membuat atau memperbarui draf terpisah.

serviceEditCopy.en: Review changes before applying a partial update to the service. Draft and validation here are local previews.
serviceEditCopy.id: Tinjau perubahan sebelum mengirim pembaruan parsial ke service. Draf dan validasi di sini hanya pratinjau lokal.

confirmServiceWrite.en: I understand this changes the service record
confirmServiceWrite.id: Saya memahami ini mengubah data di service

inviteNote.en: Invitation workflow is a proposed UI for PRD role management. No email is sent; TTL and approval options are examples.
inviteNote.id: Alur undangan adalah usulan UI pengelolaan peran PRD. Tidak ada email dikirim; TTL dan opsi persetujuan merupakan contoh.

printerNote.en: SENT means transport accepted, not proof of physical printing. A technical retry retains the existing print entitlement.
printerNote.id: SENT berarti diterima transport, bukan bukti cetak fisik. Retry teknis mempertahankan entitlement cetak yang sama.

ackNote.en: Test fixture only: online devices acknowledge their desired revision after successful validation. Offline devices remain pending.
ackNote.id: Hanya fixture pengujian: perangkat online mengakui revisi tujuan setelah validasi berhasil. Perangkat offline tetap menunggu.

error.en: This workspace could not be displayed. Try again.
error.id: Ruang kerja tidak dapat ditampilkan. Coba lagi.

localError.en: Browser storage is unavailable; changes will last only for this session.
localError.id: Penyimpanan browser tidak tersedia; perubahan hanya bertahan pada sesi ini.

validationNote.en: Local semantic checks only. Cryptographic signatures, asset hashes, hardware capabilities and canonical shared-schema validation still require backend/edge services.
validationNote.id: Hanya pemeriksaan semantik lokal. Signature kriptografi, hash aset, kapabilitas hardware dan validasi shared schema kanonis tetap memerlukan layanan backend/edge.

pendingCommands.id: Tidak ada perintah nyata yang dikirim.

applyNote.en: This records an explicit apply request. It does not operate hardware or replace a health check.
applyNote.id: Ini mencatat permintaan apply eksplisit. Tidak mengoperasikan hardware atau menggantikan pengecekan kesehatan.

effectiveNote.en: Precedence: platform defaults → device profile → campaign → audited on-site override. Null inherits; false and zero remain explicit values.
effectiveNote.id: Prioritas: default platform → profil perangkat → campaign → override di lokasi yang diaudit. Null mewarisi; false dan nol tetap nilai eksplisit.

guardrailError.en: This combination violates a safety rule. Check scope, dates, caps and references.
guardrailError.id: Kombinasi ini melanggar aturan keamanan. Periksa cakupan, tanggal, batas dan referensi.

healthHelp.en: Choose a device and scenario. Results are simulated, not live hardware measurements.
healthHelp.id: Pilih perangkat dan skenario. Hasil merupakan simulasi, bukan pengukuran hardware langsung.

guideCopy.en: Select a fleet scope, edit a draft, inspect the effective diff, validate, then simulate publishing. Verify each device acknowledgement before rollout completion.
guideCopy.id: Pilih cakupan perangkat, edit draf, tinjau perbedaan efektif, validasi, lalu simulasikan publikasi. Periksa acknowledgement setiap perangkat sebelum rollout selesai.

privacy.en: Guest identifiers and operational tokens remain masked.
privacy.id: Identitas tamu dan token operasional tetap disamarkan.

publishNeeds.en: Save and validate this exact draft before publishing.
publishNeeds.id: Simpan dan validasi draf ini sebelum publikasi.

expiresNote.en: Expired on-site overrides are excluded from effective preview.
expiresNote.id: Override di lokasi yang kedaluwarsa tidak disertakan dalam pratinjau efektif.

templateSyncApiNote.en: The API exposes device sync but does not report desired or active template versions. App version and device health are shown as separate facts; this action does not prove a template rollout.
templateSyncApiNote.id: API menyediakan sinkronisasi perangkat, tetapi tidak melaporkan versi template yang diinginkan atau aktif. Versi aplikasi dan kesehatan perangkat ditampilkan sebagai data terpisah; aksi ini tidak membuktikan rollout template.

templatePreview.en: Schematic preview · not a final rendered output
templatePreview.id: Pratinjau skematis · bukan hasil render final

roleNote.en: Example role matrix. PRD requires scoped RBAC but does not prescribe this exact permission matrix. Server-side authorization is still required.
roleNote.id: Contoh matriks peran. PRD mewajibkan RBAC terbatas tetapi tidak menentukan matriks izin ini secara persis. Otorisasi server tetap diperlukan.

metricsNote.en: Only fixture-backed counters are shown. Capture latency, render latency, clock drift, CPU/memory and restart telemetry remain unconnected.
metricsNote.id: Hanya metrik dari fixture yang ditampilkan. Telemetri latensi capture/render, penyimpangan waktu, CPU/memori dan restart belum terhubung.

allocationNote.en: Campaign is optional in the API. Initial voucher count is sent when creating the batch; use Generate vouchers later for additional codes. Confirm resulting inventory from the voucher list. Entitlement rules are JSON on the batch.
allocationNote.id: Campaign bersifat opsional pada API. Jumlah voucher awal dikirim saat membuat batch; gunakan Generate voucher untuk menambah kode setelahnya. Periksa hasil inventori pada daftar voucher. Aturan entitlement berupa JSON pada batch.

pendingPublish.en: Request saved; backend signing and delivery are pending.
pendingPublish.id: Permintaan tersimpan; penandatanganan dan pengiriman backend menunggu.

syncPending.en: Template command queued locally; active version remains unchanged.
syncPending.id: Perintah template diantrekan lokal; versi aktif tidak berubah.

backendBoundary.en: Local contract adapter · awaiting canonical backend schema
backendBoundary.id: Adapter kontrak lokal · menunggu schema backend kanonis

binaryNote.en: Uploaded bundles and image rendering are not implemented here. Fixture checks apply only to local draft templates, never to service templates.
binaryNote.id: Unggahan bundle dan render gambar belum diimplementasikan di sini. Pemeriksaan fixture hanya berlaku untuk draf template lokal, tidak untuk template dari layanan.

remoteBundleNote.en: The service contract has no bundle validation endpoint. These checks cannot be verified from template metadata; no PASS or FAILED result is inferred.
remoteBundleNote.id: Kontrak layanan tidak memiliki endpoint validasi bundle. Pemeriksaan ini tidak dapat diverifikasi dari metadata template; hasil PASS atau FAILED tidak disimpulkan.

rolesScope.en: All permissions are constrained by campaign/device scope; sensitive actions additionally require server re-authentication.
rolesScope.id: Semua izin dibatasi cakupan campaign/perangkat; aksi sensitif juga memerlukan autentikasi ulang server.

schemaFailure.en: Local schema/geometry is invalid. Fix the template draft before activation.
schemaFailure.id: Schema/geometri lokal tidak valid. Perbaiki draf template sebelum aktivasi.

sampleFailure.en: The selected failure fixture failed this check. Last-known-good stays active.
sampleFailure.id: Fixture kegagalan terpilih gagal dalam pemeriksaan ini. Last-known-good tetap aktif.

draftPreviewNote.en: Compared with the selected record or example baseline. Use Runtime configuration for the combined hierarchy preview.
draftPreviewNote.id: Dibandingkan dengan data terpilih atau baseline contoh. Gunakan Konfigurasi runtime untuk pratinjau hierarki gabungan.

templateGuard.en: Published template content is immutable. A changed bundle requires a new version; signing, binary validation and activation remain pending.
templateGuard.id: Konten template terpublikasi immutable. Bundle berubah memerlukan versi baru; penandatanganan, validasi biner dan aktivasi tetap menunggu.

apiContractCopy.en: Fields and actions on this page come directly from the current API contract and database relations.
apiContractCopy.id: Field dan aksi pada halaman ini berasal langsung dari kontrak API dan relasi database saat ini.

uploadInitiated.en: Upload session created by the service.
uploadInitiated.id: Sesi unggah berhasil dibuat oleh layanan.

uploadContractNote.en: This form initiates the multipart upload. The service response is shown exactly as returned; part transfer and completion depend on the returned upload instructions.
uploadContractNote.id: Form ini memulai unggahan multipart. Respons layanan ditampilkan persis seperti yang diterima; transfer part dan penyelesaian bergantung pada instruksi unggah yang dikembalikan.

reportsCopy.en: Revenue, voucher, and session reports returned by the reporting endpoints.
reportsCopy.id: Laporan pendapatan, voucher, dan sesi dari endpoint pelaporan.

copy.en: Register a device with the button above. The table is the device list. Open a row for health, profiles, and assignments. Camera and printer profiles are managed from the card below the table.
copy.id: Daftarkan perangkat lewat tombol di atas. Tabel ini adalah daftar perangkat. Buka satu baris untuk kesehatan, profil, dan assignment. Profil kamera dan printer dikelola dari kartu di bawah tabel.

copy.en: Create a campaign with the button above. Open a row to edit that campaign, its booths, and its device assignments.
copy.id: Buat campaign lewat tombol di atas. Buka satu baris untuk mengedit campaign itu, booth-nya, dan assignment perangkatnya.

copy.en: Add a frame template with the button above. Open a row to edit that template and its publish state. Device sync is in the card below the table.
copy.id: Tambah frame template lewat tombol di atas. Buka satu baris untuk mengedit template itu dan status publikasinya. Sinkronisasi perangkat ada di kartu di bawah tabel.

copy.en: Create a voucher batch with the button above. Open a row to edit that batch and generate codes. Voucher records are in the card below the table.
copy.id: Buat voucher batch lewat tombol di atas. Buka satu baris untuk mengedit batch itu dan membuat kode. Data voucher ada di kartu di bawah tabel.

copy.en: Daily revenue, booth revenue, campaign revenue, voucher batches, and the session funnel returned by the service.
copy.id: Pendapatan harian, pendapatan booth, pendapatan campaign, voucher batch, dan funnel sesi dari service.

copy.en: Guest identifiers and operational tokens remain masked.
copy.id: Identitas tamu dan token operasional tetap disamarkan.

copy.en: Guest identifiers and operational tokens remain masked.
copy.id: Identitas tamu dan token operasional tetap disamarkan.

copy.en: Initiate multipart uploads using the file workflow exposed by the service.
copy.id: Mulai unggahan multipart menggunakan alur file yang tersedia pada layanan.

copy.en: Camera and printer profiles that can be assigned to devices.
copy.id: Profil kamera dan printer yang dapat ditetapkan ke perangkat.

copy.en: Run the device sync operation exposed by the API.
copy.id: Jalankan operasi sinkronisasi perangkat yang tersedia pada API.

copy.en: Inspect current voucher status, batch, session, device, and lifecycle timestamps from the service.
copy.id: Tinjau status voucher saat ini, batch, sesi, perangkat, dan waktu siklus hidup dari service.
